audit: Read-only structural audit of current Phase B follow-up implementation contracts

checks.contract: Practice episodes are durably reserved before simulation, and a normal experiment cannot exceed 200 practice episodes.

evidence.finding: TrainConfig defaults total_episodes to 200 and accepts exactly 200 for normal runs (10 for code tests).
EpisodeBudget rejects limits above 200, refuses changed limits, and persists each reservation before returning IDs.
Runner creates the ledger before collection; it reserves the next ten IDs before calling episodes.practice, and reuses already-reserved saved batches after interruption.

checks.note: Reserved ledger entries remain consumed if a run stops after reservation; the run resumes saved data or refuses to recollect a spent batch.

checks.contract: Test data is not inserted into replay or counted in heat-map ratings.

evidence.finding: Test runs return summaries and traces through a separate method and do not call Replay.add.
Heat-map updates read the practice Replay after practice insertion; tests are run separately and never passed to after_collect or Replay.add.
Every insertion calls require_practice and checks required practice provenance.
Only fill/online sources with reserved IDs and test_only=false can satisfy require_practice.

checks.contract: Success labels use the run’s own practice next_obs and do not read true_bias.

evidence.finding: success_targets scans only replay episode IDs, orders each episode by step, selects its first success, and uses next_obs[first,:2] as the label; the function does not access true_bias.
Labels are built only during an update from that run’s Replay.
Test execution is a separate runner path and exposes no replay insertion path.

checks.contract: Fixed camera bias remains constant within each run, and Phase B does not pass hidden bias to actor or critic.

evidence.finding: A fixed XY bias is generated once when the environment is constructed from fixed_bias_seed and applied to the observation bias on reset/step observation construction.
For fixed-camera jobs the config is replaced with fixed_bias_seed=practice seed; a different config creates a new runner/environment for that seed.
Reset and step pass their info mapping through _get_obs and return that info mapping in state, so FollowupEnv’s bias override persists in state info during the run.
True bias is passed to Q only behind privileged_critic; otherwise the critic receives observation/action only. Bias is retained in traces/replay for analysis.
privileged_critic defaults false; Phase B switches are rejected when combined with privileged_critic.
Training data includes true_bias only under privileged_critic, and critic concatenates it only under the same flag.
Current Phase B entries have hidden_information=false and no privileged_critic override=true.

checks.configuration_guard_note: FollowupConfig does not forbid privileged_critic for a plain Phase B configuration with no Phase B switch. Current Phase B registry entries do not enable it; this remains a possible configuration mistake if a future entry is added.

checks.contract: Fresh choosing seeds 200–204 with test seed 1001 are blocked until a written choice exists.

evidence.finding: Runner rejects fresh seed/test pairs before G/choice.json and requires the paired 200–204/1001 pair; otherwise choosing is restricted to practice 0–4/test123.
Fresh seed-1001 reference measurement is independently blocked until G/choice.json exists.
Job measures references before constructing/running a learner, but the reference function has its own seed-1001 gate and runner.run applies the paired-seed gate.

checks.contract: Full time-series test traces are saved only for final 500-episode tests or required ceiling verification.

evidence.finding: Curve checks use 256 episodes (or 8 in code tests); the trace output path is set only when the evaluation has 500 episodes, which is the normal final check.
Additional 500-episode traces are written only when a movement/combined method exceeds the no-camera-bias ceiling, with the verification summary marked used_for_selection=false.
The generic test helper accepts an optional output path; the production runner call sites control when a full trace path is supplied.

checks.scope_note: The full-trace restriction is enforced by FollowupRunner call sites rather than inside the general FollowupEpisodes.test API.

checks.contract: Initial learned actor outputs and the starting guess are zero before learning.

evidence.finding: Actor’s final Dense layer has zero kernel and bias initializers, so its initial output is zero.
Follow-up actor is initialized through that zero-output actor; FollowupState starts with a zero two-dimensional guess, and the success-label head’s initial direct prediction is also zero.
During fill-up the policy mean action is explicitly replaced by zeros before the configured exploration noise is added; constant-fill offsets are separately flagged.

checks.note: Fill-up can contain configured exploration noise or the explicitly configured constant offset; those are not learned actor outputs.

existing_test_log.warning: The log reports a JAXopt deprecation warning.

uncertainties_or_code_gaps: The reusable config permits privileged_critic=true for a plain Phase B configuration with no Phase B trick switch; current registry entries set hidden_information=false and do not enable the flag.
Full-trace exclusivity is a runner-call-site convention; direct callers of FollowupEpisodes.test can supply an output path for other test sizes.
